name: TCRMHC UX/UI Phase 6.1 — Enterprise Positions Polish
review_findings: Phase 6 is functional and consistent but visually reads as polished admin UI rather than enterprise-premium software.
The main screen has excessive unused canvas relative to the density of the directory data.
Typography, table hierarchy, and information density are too lightweight for an enterprise governance workspace.
Create Position is a conventional modal rather than a structured enterprise workflow.
Manage Position is a centered generic modal; Phase 6.1 turns it into a dedicated full-height governance workspace.
The existing Help Audience mapping is functional but needs stronger policy context and hierarchy.
Uploaded Phase 6 screenshot 02 is not actually Dark Mode.
Uploaded Phase 6 screenshots 08 and 09 are byte-identical despite Light/Dark labels.
Uploaded Phase 6 screenshots 10 and 12 are byte-identical, so Help Audience mapping coverage was duplicated rather than independently captured.
Mobile screenshots 14/15 and Execute-running screenshot 18 were not present.
scope: Enterprise command-header treatment with real scope context
Three real operational summary cards using existing loaded data only
Enterprise directory heading and live catalog indicator
Stronger sticky data-grid hierarchy and row affordances
No backend, database, authorization or API changes
expected_commit_message: feat: elevate positions UX to enterprise premium
